basic_details.scholarship_name: Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST) International Graduate Scholarship & Full Research Assistantship
basic_details.offering_entity: Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST) & Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT), South Korea
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: GIST Main Campus (Buk-gu, Gwangju, South Korea)
basic_details.major_restrictions: School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, School of Materials Science and Engineering, School of Mechanical Engineering, School of Environmental Science and Engineering, School of Life Sciences, Department of Physics and Photon Science, and Department of Chemistry.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~120 to 160 international graduate fellowships awarded annually across departments
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Extensive international cohort; typically 20 to 30 Pakistani researchers in photonics, computing, and engineering appointed annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 semesters (2 years) for Master's; 8 semesters (4 years) for PhD; 10 semesters (5 years) for Combined MS/PhD
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: Combined tuition waiver and stipend: 100% full tuition covered plus KRW 140,000 / month student allowance, KRW 290,000 / month meal allowance, and research assistantship: Total monthly living allowance typically KRW 1,000,000 to 1,400,000 / month for Master's (~PKR 210,000 to 294,000 / month) and KRW 1,400,000 to 1,900,000 / month for PhD (~PKR 294,000 to 399,000 / month)

nationality_requirements: International applicants whose parents both hold non-Korean citizenship (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No statutory maximum age limit, though priority is given to young researchers with exceptional academic momentum.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree with minimum CGPA 3.20/4.00 for Master's; recognized 18-year Master's degree with minimum CGPA 3.20/4.00 for PhD from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.20 / 4.00; competitive applicants at GIST typically possess CGPA >= 3.50 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Electrical engineering, computer science, photonics, materials science, mechanical engineering, environmental engineering, life sciences, physics, or chemistry.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year undergraduate/master's students completing degree requirements before semester start.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior scientific publications in photonics, laser physics, materials, or computing journals provide a substantial competitive edge.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5, TOEFL iBT minimum 80, TOEIC 750+, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from an accredited university.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Korean language proficiency is not required; 100% of graduate lectures, research, and dissertations are conducted in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to all qualified applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: All admitted international graduate students receive the GIST Scholarship and research assistantship automatically upon admission.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another parallel government fellowship covering identical living and tuition benefits.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver covering all standard degree semesters at GIST.

admission_application_fee.details: GIST does not charge an application fee for international graduate applicants.

accommodation.details: On-campus international graduate dormitory housing in Gwangju (dormitory fee approx. KRW 100,000 to 160,000 / month), paid easily from living stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Combined institutional allowance, meal subsidy, and laboratory research assistantship: KRW 1,000,000 to 1,400,000 / month for Master's; KRW 1,400,000 to 1,900,000 / month for PhD.

airfare.details: One-way international airfare to South Korea is reimbursed upon arrival for newly enrolling international graduate students.
airfare.amount: One-way flight reimbursement provided by GIST

visa_fee.details: South Korean D-2 Student Visa fee paid directly to the Korean Embassy in Islamabad.

health_insurance.details: Mandatory enrollment in Korea National Health Insurance Service (NHIS); subsidized monthly premium (approx. KRW 70,000 / month) paid from stipend.

food_allowance.details: GIST provides a dedicated monthly meal allowance (KRW 290,000 / month) included in student support package.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to GIST Central Library, Center for Relativistic Laser Science (CoReLS holding world-record 4-petawatt laser), and cleanrooms.
books_and_materials_allowance.amount: 100% covered world-leading laser and photonics lab access

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Laboratory research grants cover international conference registration, travel, and accommodation for accepted papers.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized transit connecting GIST campus to Gwangju-Songjeong KTX Station (connecting to Seoul in 1.5 hours).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single South Korea national research institute (GIST, Gwangju).
participating_institutions: Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST Campus, Buk-gu, Gwangju, South Korea)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #307 globally, Ranked #4 in the world for citations per faculty (QS World Rankings 2024); home to the world's most powerful petawatt laser research center (CoReLS).
available_majors: Master's / PhD in School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
Master's / PhD in School of Materials Science and Engineering
Master's / PhD in School of Mechanical Engineering
Master's / PhD in Department of Physics and Photon Science
Master's / PhD in School of Environmental Science and Engineering
Master's / PhD in School of Life Sciences
Master's / PhD in Department of Chemistry
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master's: 2 years; PhD: 4 years; Combined MS/PhD: 5 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree with CGPA >= 3.20/4.00, academic transcripts, statement of purpose, two recommendation letters, English test score (IELTS 6.5+ / TOEFL 80+ / MOI), and CV.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, and Physics & Photon Science are world-leading; contacting professors before applying significantly increases selection probability.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus research proposals on ultra-intense laser physics, photonics, AI algorithms, or environmental nanomaterials where GIST holds premier national research institutes.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the GIST admissions portal, complete online application form (no application fee charged), upload personal statement and transcripts, and dispatch certified physical documents to Section of International Admissions.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Contact prospective GIST professors in target research areas with CV and research interests (July-August for Spring / December-January for Fall).
Step 2: Register on GIST Online Graduate Admissions System during open intake.
Step 3: Complete online application and upload documents (application fee is completely free).
Step 4: Register two academic recommenders who submit evaluation letters online.
Step 5: Send certified hard-copy documents (degrees, transcripts, apostille/attestation) via DHL to GIST International Admissions in Gwangju.
Step 6: Departmental faculty committee reviews dossiers and conducts virtual technical interviews.
Step 7: Final admission and scholarship award results announced online.
Step 8: Obtain Certificate of Admission (CoA), apply for South Korean D-2 visa, and arrive in Gwangju (flight reimbursement processed upon arrival).
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Institutional Route: Admission and scholarship funding are decided together based on departmental faculty recommendation.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by two academic recommenders via confidential portal links.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose and Study Plan (prescribed GIST format) describing motivation, research experiences, scholarly interests, and post-graduation goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research plan detailing proposed technical investigations, methodologies, and alignment with target GIST laboratories.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic research CV detailing education, laboratory proficiencies, software skills, and publication history.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical interview via Zoom conducted by prospective supervisor and departmental faculty panel.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+, TOEFL iBT 80+, TOEIC 750+, or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate accepted.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC and MoFA Pakistan attestations required, followed by Korean Embassy consular legalization in Islamabad or Apostille.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Korean translation for all non-English/non-Korean documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Dual submission: Online portal application followed by mandatory postal dispatch of certified physical dossier to GIST.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete Bachelor's / Master's degree certificates and transcripts with CGPA >= 3.20/4.00.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC, MoFA, and consular legalized by Korean Embassy Islamabad.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Completed on official GIST form detailing background, motivation, research interests, and career goals.
Confidential evaluation letters from academic professors submitted electronically.
IELTS Academic 6.5+, TOEFL iBT 80+, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate.
Comprehensive academic CV detailing publications, research projects, technical skills, and awards.
Family Registration Certificate (FRC) and copies of passports of applicant and parents.

important_dates_timeline.document_submission_deadline: October 5 / April 5 (Hard copy postal arrival in Gwangju)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Bi-annual intake: Spring semester starts in March, Fall semester starts in September.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Prior CGPA, academic rigor in engineering/science, university standing)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (Technical research capability, publications, programming skills, research proposal)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 5% (Clarity of vision and alignment with GIST research priorities)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: GIST Departmental Admissions Committee, School Graduate Deans, and Admissions Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Rigorous holistic evaluation assessing mathematical ability, research productivity, experimental aptitude, and alignment with faculty laboratories.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,400 to 1,900 international applicants across both intakes
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~120 to 160 fully funded international awards annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~14.0% to 18.0% for applicants with strong research profiles and CGPA >= 3.50
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Undergraduate/Master's CGPA >= 3.50 / 4.00, accompanied by strong programming skills or publications
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with solid records in photonics, electrical engineering, computing, or materials science, documented laboratory experience, and professor alignment.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from top Pakistani universities (NUST, FAST-NUCES, UET Lahore, GIKI, PIEAS, COMSATS, Quaid-i-Azam).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Vietnam, China, India, Indonesia, Turkey, Iran, Russia.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official portal gist.ac.kr.
GIST does not work with third-party agents; all applications must be submitted directly by the candidate.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying to GIST is completely free of charge (USD 0).
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Applications prepared by commercial agents are rejected; authentic personal statements and research experience are essential.
hidden_costs_breakdown: NADRA FRC and document attestations (HEC, MoFA, Korean Embassy): ~PKR 35,000 to 50,000.
DHL document courier to South Korea: ~PKR 12,000.
Flight to South Korea: Reimbursed upon arrival by GIST.
Initial living deposit before first stipend payment: ~KRW 500,000 (~PKR 105,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Korean TOPIK certificate is needed. Reality: 100% of graduate education at GIST is conducted in English.
Myth: Application fee required. Reality: GIST is one of the few Korean institutions with zero application fee.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sites claim GIST requires GRE; GRE is optional and not mandatory for international graduate admissions.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain minimum semester GPA of 3.00 out of 4.30 to retain the fellowship and tuition waiver each semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research presence at GIST campus; daily participation in laboratory research activities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual academic progress review evaluated by research advisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is restricted under Korean immigration law; part-time work requires permission from immigration and university.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates are eligible for Korean D-10 job seeker visas or E-7 professional engineering visas upon graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Tuition waiver is cancelled if semester GPA drops below 3.00 or if student is dismissed for disciplinary infractions.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major change requires approval from current advisor, new advisor, and department heads.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions beyond standard 4 semesters (Master's) or 8 semesters (PhD) are generally not covered by the scholarship.
